text:
sam: Hi @people-ops — quick one: can I add my 8yo stepchild to my Redwood medical + dental? They moved in two weeks ago and are on an H-4 visa. We don’t have a US SSN for them yet.

people-ops: Hey Sam :wave: likely yes, but carriers vary about non‑SSN dependents. Don’t post PII here. Please DM or use Secure Upload.

sam: What docs will carriers accept if we only have passport, visa, and a school enrollment letter? No ITIN yet.

lisa-hr: Typical carrier checklist for foreign-born dependents without SSN: passport + visa page, I-94 entry record (if available), proof of shared residence (lease or school record), custody/adoption/step relationship proof (marriage certificate + birth certificate linking parent), and a signed affidavit if tax status isn’t aligned. Some carriers accept a notice of SSN application or ITIN application as temporary evidence.

people-ops: Two practical notes: 1) if you enroll now and SSN arrives later, you must provide it to the carrier within their timeframe. 2) Retro effective dates: carriers will consider an effective date based on when you request enrollment and when docs are received. Many allow retro only 30 days; some up to 60 depending on the QLE.

sam: Our QLE is "moved into household" — is that valid?

lisa-hr: Yes, adding a dependent due to a change in household (child moving in) is a common QLE. We’ll need supporting docs showing the move date.

people-ops: Please upload docs to Secure Upload -> "Dependent Eligibility (International)": https://redwood.hr/secure-upload. Mark the move-in date in the upload notes.

benefits-bot: Reminder: upload within 30 days to avoid denial. Checklist: https://redwood.hr/dependents-checklist :lock: :calendar:

sam: Uploaded passport, visa, school letter, and a signed affidavit confirming financial support. No SSN yet.

people-ops: Got it. Well review and send to carrier. Expect 7-14 business days for carrier confirmation. If carrier requires ITIN/SSN later, well follow up.

raj: FWIW we had a similar case last year — carrier approved enrollment pending SSN, and payroll pro-rated from the carrier effective date once SSN was provided.

people-ops: Thanks @raj. Keeping this thread for the audit trail. Well post carrier decision here once available.
